subject: delta(client): WF pass the session's node endpoint rule to paid-write planning
note: projectPaidWrite read the wallet's transport without the node endpoint rule its session admitted it under, so it fell back to the provider's https-only check and a session on a plain-http testnet root refused every paid write with not_configured. projectPaidWrite now takes an optional nodeEndpoint and passes it to readTransport; createSdkWalletSession passes its own nodeEndpoint at both of its calls, and createPaidApproval takes nodeEndpoint and passes it on, with the Node session giving it canonicalNodeEndpoint. Without nodeEndpoint the planner keeps the https-only check. node-endpoint.test.mjs adds a keystore composition over a plain-http root under the approved identity that prepares a paid write once and still sends nothing unapproved, and the planner refusing that transport without the rule.
